boxes.question: Does the response read as a film review of *The Great Buddha+* directed by Huang Hsin-yao?
Does it describe the two workers, Cai Pu and Du Cai, peeking into the upper-class world through black-and-white surveillance cameras?
Does it connect the film’s black-and-white and color imagery to its portrayal of Taiwan’s class divide?
Does it discuss the golden Buddha as a symbolic motif?

Does it explain how the film’s dark humor dissects social pathology?
